verified_sources.source_name: Public Authority for Housing Welfare (PAHW) - Al-Mutlaa Building Code & Regulations
verified_sources.key_insights: 400m² standard plot parameters in Al-Mutlaa (N1 to N12) and West Abdullah Al-Mubarak. Facade height allowances (up to 3 floors + basement), mandatory thermal insulation (MEW conservation code).

verified_sources.source_name: Kuwait Building Materials & Cement Products Co. (KPC) - Heavy Sigma Standards
verified_sources.key_insights: Modified acrylic/silicone resin Sigma with graded quartz aggregates (1.5mm - 2.5mm). Wind pressure and extreme sandstorm abrasion resistance for open desert peripheral residential cities.

verified_sources.source_name: Al-Mutlaa & West Abdullah Al-Mubarak Contractors Guild Ledger 2026
verified_sources.key_insights: Turnkey plastering + external insulation (EPS/Rockwool) + fiberglass mesh + basecoat + Sigma finishing pricing in new cities (4.800 to 7.200 KWD/sqm). Payment milestone scheduling, defect liabilities, and avoiding fly-by-night subcontractors.
